sections.chapter_title: Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)
sections.section_title: FDCAN Tx buffer add request register (FDCAN_TXBAR)
sections.text_helper: Section 71.5.38 "FDCAN Tx buffer add request register (FDCAN_TXBAR)" in chapter 71 (Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3712.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x00D0
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:0 AR[31:0]:Add request
Each Tx buffer has its own add request bit. Writing a 1 sets the corresponding add request bit; writing
a 0 has no impact. This enables the user to set transmission requests for multiple Tx buffers with one
write to FDCAN_TXBAR. FDCAN_TXBAR bits are set only for those Tx buffers configured via
FDCAN_TXBC. When no Tx scan is running, the bits are reset immediately, else the bits remain set
until the Tx scan process has completed.
0: No transmission request added
1: Transmission requested added.
Note: If an add request is applied for a Tx buffer with pending transmission request
(corresponding FDCAN_TXBRP bit already set), the request is ignored.
